opportunities.name: Pack health spell fighter
opportunities.objective: Test pack health spell fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Call of the Pack grants 20% total AD for five seconds; Bloodmail's purchased-health AD feeds physical Q/E/R damage during that window. Shojin favors repeated spells and Sundered Sky rewards Naafiri's own attack after E; Visage supports Q healing and the conditional second-R shield.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep packmates alive and earn the R recast through a takedown.
opportunities.failure: Delayed damage loses the seven-second takedown window.
opportunities.test: Compare two Q casts and E with pack count held constant.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Packmates do not automatically inherit Sundered Sky or Naafiri's item attack effects.

opportunities.name: Attack weave hunt reset
opportunities.objective: Test attack weave hunt reset against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Naafiri's W untargetability grants a five-second AD/movement window; E recalls and heals packmates while positioning her for Trinity's physical Spellblade attack. Blade of the Ruined King adds personal attack pressure, while Eclipse supports a short Q-plus-attack trade before R cleanup.
opportunities.requiredState: Stay within personal attack range after W/E and land both daggers.
opportunities.failure: Missing haste and raw burst can prevent the first hunt reset.
opportunities.test: Count Naafiri-only attacks between Q casts, comparing pack damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Dogs are not three guaranteed PTA attacks; only actual qualifying owner attacks count.

ruledOut.reason: Packmates do not automatically inherit Sundered Sky or Naafiri's item attack effects.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Pack health spell fighter
builds.summary: Test pack health spell fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test pack health spell fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: The Call of the Pack grants 20% total AD for five seconds; Bloodmail's purchased-health AD feeds physical Q/E/R damage during that window. Shojin favors repeated spells and Sundered Sky rewards Naafiri's own attack after E; Visage supports Q healing and the conditional second-R shield.
testPlan: Required state: Keep packmates alive and earn the R recast through a takedown.
Compare two Q casts and E with pack count held constant.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Delayed damage loses the seven-second takedown window.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Packmates do not automatically inherit Sundered Sky or Naafiri's item attack effects.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Spear of Shojin, Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Naafiri creates a Packmate every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, increased to [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.3)] after she uses an Ability. 

Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by [4] seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by [1] seconds.

Max Packmates: [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]

Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalDamageFirstCast@ physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalBleedDamage@ physical damage over @spell.NaafiriQ:BleedDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMinDamageSecondCast@ and @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMaxDamageSecondCast@ physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalHealSecondCast@ Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for @spell.NaafiriP:PackmateTauntDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing [125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing [(125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.1)] physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within [7] seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants [100 / 150 / 200 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [3] seconds.

Naafiri becomes Untargetable for [1] second and prepares to hunt, spawning [2] additional Packmates and gaining [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed for [5] seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

Naafiri surges forward, dealing [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.
